evals.name: restore-once
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, design a CI sequence that restores once.
evals.expected_output: Run dotnet restore once and pass --no-restore afterward.
assertions: Runs a single explicit restore step.
Keeps configuration and property flags consistent between steps.

evals.name: netsdk1004
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, explain NETSDK1004 after adding --no-restore.
evals.expected_output: assets file not found because no restore ran or restored different inputs.
assertions: Warns that different properties produce a different restore.

evals.name: rsp-file
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, explain Directory.Build.rsp for this.
evals.expected_output: rsp provides default switches for msbuild invocation.
assertions: Describes the file providing default MSBuild arguments.
Notes it affects only the msbuild invocation scope.
Warns not to suppress restore blindly.
